newsitem.title: USA: Times Mirror November ad revenues rose.
newsitem.headline: Times Mirror November ad revenues rose.

text.p: Times Mirror Co said that advertising revenues for Times Mirror's Newspaper Publishing Group for the four weeks ended December 1, 1996, increased 4.4 percent to $139,772,000 from $133,922,000 in the prior year.

For the forty-eight weeks January 1, 1996 through December 1, 1996, total advertising revenues rose 2.3 percent to $1,442,586,000 compared with $1,410,648,000 for the period January 1, 1995 through November 26, 1995. The year-to-date results for 1996 contained six more days than the 1995 results.
